schema.headline: Why Isn't My PDF Tool Working? A Troubleshooting Guide
schema.description: Start with the actual error and a non-sensitive sample when a tool fails. The cause may be the document, browser resources, a blocked runtime download, or a product defect. Local document processing does not mean every failure is local or user-fixable.

mainEntity.name: Why doesn't the error message tell me exactly what went wrong?

acceptedAnswer.text: A processing error can have several causes. For Protect/Unlock, a qpdf status failure alone cannot reliably distinguish a wrong password from a damaged or unsupported PDF.

mainEntity.name: Is there a file size limit on PDFcraft?

acceptedAnswer.text: Practical limits depend on browser capabilities, available memory, and document complexity. A large or complex file may fail; keep your original and check the downloaded result.

mainEntity.name: Will my file be lost if a tool fails partway through?

acceptedAnswer.text: The selected source is not overwritten by processing. Preserve it when saving downloads; cleanup is not a secure-erasure guarantee.

mainEntity.name: Does this happen because of a bug, or is it expected behavior?

acceptedAnswer.text: Either is possible. File validity, resources, runtime access, and application defects can cause failures. Keep the actual error when asking for help.

routes.title: PDF vs Word — Which Format Should You Use? | PDFcraft

schema.name: PDFcraft
schema.description: Free browser-based PDF tools by Dajai Studio. Document contents are processed locally, with no account required.

schema.headline: PDF vs Word — Which Format Should You Use?
schema.description: Choose the format by what the next person must do: revise the wording, review a fixed page layout, or submit a file to a system with its own requirements. Keep the editable working document even when you deliver a PDF. PDFcraft can organize supported PDF pages, but it does not convert them into Word documents or edit their existing paragraphs.

mainEntity.name: Should I send both the Word source and a PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only if the recipient needs both roles: an editable working file and a layout reference. Agree which version is authoritative; sending two unexplained versions can create avoidable revision confusion.

mainEntity.name: Does a PDF prevent a recipient from editing the document?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The format is not inherently tamper-proof. Format choice, opening access and signature validation are separate decisions; this guide does not promise editing prevention.

mainEntity.name: Can PDFcraft turn a PDF into an editable Word file?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFcraft provides supported page operations and image output, not DOC or DOCX generation, existing-text editing or OCR. Use the editable source or a separate conversion workflow.

mainEntity.name: When should I avoid converting back from PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: When you still have the current editable source, revise that source and export a new delivery copy. Reconstruction from PDF can require layout corrections and is not a replacement for keeping the working document.

schema.headline: How to Password-Protect a PDF on Mac
schema.description: Before choosing a Mac PDF protection method, separate two needs: requiring a password to open the document, and managing permissions after it opens. Preview documents controls for both. PDFcraft provides a narrower opening-password workflow. Pick the capability your recipient actually needs rather than treating every password dialog as the same security feature.

mainEntity.name: Is an owner password the same as requiring a password to open?

acceptedAnswer.text: They are different controls in Preview documentation. Choose the opening requirement explicitly when a password prompt before reading is the goal.

mainEntity.name: Can PDFcraft reproduce all Preview permission settings?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Its Protect workflow adds opening-password encryption and permits printing and extraction; it is not an equivalent permission-management interface.

mainEntity.name: Does this comparison establish which encryption algorithm Preview uses?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The Apple help page supports the documented controls, not a cipher-equivalence or security-strength comparison with PDFcraft.

mainEntity.name: What should I check before sending the protected copy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reopen the saved output with the intended password, inspect its contents and confirm that the recipient accepts encrypted files and can obtain the password.

mainEntity.name: Why does a PDF open but remain difficult to edit?

acceptedAnswer.text: First check whether your viewer offers editing and what its security panel reports. If the page is a scanned image, opening it does not create editable text. PDFcraft Unlock only decrypts; PDFcraft has no OCR or existing-text editor.

mainEntity.name: Does Unlock repair a damaged PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a decryption tool, not a general PDF repair service. Request a valid copy when the input is damaged.

mainEntity.name: Will numbering replace the numbers already printed in my PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. New text is drawn on top of the pages. Existing numbers stay in the content and may overlap the additions unless you choose another position.

mainEntity.name: Why do my viewer's page labels still differ from the added numbers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Viewer labels come from page positions or PDF page-label metadata. This tool adds visible numbers only; it does not update that metadata.

mainEntity.name: Why did my compressed PDF become larger?

acceptedAnswer.text: Saving with object streams can add overhead or reorganize an already-efficient file. A larger result is valid evidence that this structural rewrite did not help that input; keep the smaller original if it meets your needs.

mainEntity.name: Can I request a PDF below 500 KB?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no target-byte-size control. The tool reports the size it actually produced; it does not repeatedly reduce image quality until a limit is reached.

mainEntity.name: Can this redact confidential information?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It removes selected visible pages, not every recoverable copy of their information. Use a workflow specifically designed and verified for secure redaction when irreversible removal is required.

mainEntity.name: Why does a link disappear after I delete a page?

acceptedAnswer.text: If its local destination was on the deleted page, the navigation is removed. Redirecting it to the next page would invent a destination and could mislead readers.

acceptedAnswer.text: Image dimensions are used directly as PDF page dimensions. Choose a print scaling option in your viewer, or prepare images at the dimensions your workflow requires; this tool has no A4 or Letter fitting control.

mainEntity.name: Can renaming a HEIC photo to JPG make it work?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The input must contain valid JPEG or PNG data. Convert it to a supported image format before using this tool.

mainEntity.name: Why does a form PDF fail to merge?

acceptedAnswer.text: The safe page-copy path currently rejects AcroForm structures. A visible form page and its document-level field tree are different things; copying only the page would not prove that the form still works.

mainEntity.name: Will the merged file open at the same bookmark as a source file?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. Source OpenActions are omitted to avoid importing competing opening instructions. Supported bookmarks remain available for navigation inside the combined document.

mainEntity.name: Why is my grayscale PDF no longer searchable?

acceptedAnswer.text: Its pages are newly embedded JPEG images. The original text objects are not transferred, and this converter does not run OCR to recreate them.

mainEntity.name: Why did converting to grayscale increase the file size?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rendering a page into a JPEG can require more bytes than its original text and vector instructions. Removing color does not guarantee a smaller PDF.

mainEntity.name: Why can I no longer select words in the downloaded JPG?

acceptedAnswer.text: The JPG contains page pixels, not PDF text objects. Use the original PDF when selectable text matters; this image exporter does not perform OCR.

mainEntity.name: Will PNG give me the original vector artwork?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PNG is still a rasterized page at the tool's fixed rendering scale. Lossless PNG encoding does not turn the exported pixels back into vectors.

mainEntity.name: Can I download just page 4?

acceptedAnswer.text: Conversion processes the whole document, but each resulting image has its own download control. Choose page 4's image after rendering finishes.

mainEntity.name: Does Protect prevent a recipient from printing or extracting content?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The current qpdf options explicitly allow full printing and extraction. Anyone given the opening password should be treated as able to access the document's contents.

mainEntity.name: Can I set a different owner password?

acceptedAnswer.text: This interface uses the same entered value for the user and owner passwords. Separate password and permission settings are not available here.

mainEntity.name: Can PDFcraft recover a forgotten protection password?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no password recovery feature. Retain an original copy and store the password before relying on the encrypted output.

mainEntity.name: Can I drag page thumbnails into a new order?

acceptedAnswer.text: No thumbnail or drag-order interface is implemented. Use the Up and Down controls beside the numbered entries, then save the new sequence.

mainEntity.name: Will a 90-degree rotation make every page portrait?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The same additional angle is applied to every page. Existing orientation and page dimensions determine whether each resulting page appears portrait or landscape.

mainEntity.name: Does rotation change the order of my pages?

acceptedAnswer.text: The rotation handler visits the current pages in place and does not reorder them. It changes their rotation values, then saves another PDF.

mainEntity.name: How do I make one PDF containing pages 1-3 and 7-10?

acceptedAnswer.text: Split those two ranges, then merge the resulting PDFs in the desired order. Entering 1-3, 7-10 in Split creates two files rather than one nonconsecutive selection.

mainEntity.name: Why can one problematic range prevent every download?

acceptedAnswer.text: Split validates the full requested batch before exposing results. If a range leaves an unsupported action chain or fails navigation validation, no partial batch is offered.

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Its purpose is decryption with the supplied password. It provides no page-repair or signature-repair workflow, and signature preservation is not verified.
